Surfaces.Contract: Execution reports a terminal command failure once after cleanup. Inspection of a discarded queue, a not-ready pending, or a WATCH abort owns its lifecycle failure; repeated inspection does not republish it. Successful inspection rents no error lease.

Boundaries.Name: deferred-inspection
Boundaries.Contract: Execution reports a terminal command failure once after cleanup. Inspection of a discarded queue, a not-ready pending, or a WATCH abort owns its lifecycle failure; repeated inspection does not republish it. Successful inspection rents no error lease.

Boundaries.Name: deferred-error-publication
Boundaries.Contract: Publish each terminal command failure once only after execution and mutation cleanup. Preserve its original exception and complete retry count. Added retries saturate at int.MaxValue and never reduce the count; final publication rejects later count updates. Success releases retry storage without publishing.
